newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Danube flood waters begin to recede in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Danube flood waters begin to recede in Hungary.

text.p: The level of the river Danube passed its peak of 7.55 metres at Budapest on Thursday and is now receding, Hungary's National Water Management Directorate told news agency MTI.
The river failed to breach the city's flood defences but high-level flood alerts are still in force along the upper Hungarian section of the river up to the city of Esztergom.

Earlier, the government said it was pledging another 100 million forints ($500,000) to help reinforce some of the country's 4,200 km of dikes, many of which are now sodden and could still be in danger of being breached by reamining flood water. ($ = 195.5 Hungarian Forints)
